notes: Rebuilds the Dashboard to match the approved showcase mockup: typography, spacing, panel density, readiness rings, alert severity colors, collection graphs, activity rows and quick actions.
Replaces live collection photos in the dashboard hero with purpose-built static ArmoryGrid showcase artwork so the composition remains consistent for every collection.
Makes the dashboard a deliberate dark showcase surface in both Dark and Light appearance modes while leaving the rest of the application theme-aware.
Makes the sidebar collection Viewing selector structurally unique and adds a defensive CSS rule so duplicate Viewing controls cannot render.
